purpose: Frozen literature targets for deterministic verification, calibration checks and external holdout validation of the T1D Simulator activity model.

romeres2021AerobicFlux.protocol: 60 min continuous aerobic exercise at 65% VO2max under glucose/insulin clamp conditions.
romeres2021AerobicFlux.use: Mechanistic calibration only; not an external holdout.

shetty2021HyperinsulinemicClamp.protocol: 40 min continuous aerobic exercise during a hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp at 5-6 mmol/L.
shetty2021HyperinsulinemicClamp.population: Nine recreationally active young adults with type 1 diabetes; only two completed 40 min at 80% VO2peak.
shetty2021HyperinsulinemicClamp.interpretation: The three game intensities can test 35%, 50% and 80%. The separate 65% maximum is not identifiable without a fourth aerobic intensity or a continuous workload input.

t1dexi2023ExerciseTypes.protocol: Approximately 30 min structured at-home exercise using aerobic, interval or resistance videos.
t1dexi2023ExerciseTypes.population: 497 adults with type 1 diabetes; 2,756 sessions in a free-living setting.
t1dexi2023ExerciseTypes.interpretation: Use as a broad population holdout. The three fictional body archetypes are not a representative virtual population.

toghiEshghi2019ContextReversal.protocol: Resistance exercise compared between a fasted morning condition and a fed afternoon condition.
toghiEshghi2019ContextReversal.interpretation: The primary target is reversal of direction. Exact magnitude is secondary because meal, bolus, work and participant parameters are only approximated.

rempel2018Intervals.protocol: 45 min at 45-55% heart-rate reserve with six 60 s intervals every four minutes at 70%, 80% or 90% heart-rate reserve.
rempel2018Intervals.interpretation: Not testable by the current continuous mixed-activity category because it lacks explicit work/recovery intervals.
